svg.aria-label: Skriptly architecture: the browser records or uploads audio and sends it with a JWT straight to a Flask container, which checks the plan, injects the user's vocabulary and routes on duration. Short recordings go to one GPU worker; long ones go to a CPU orchestrator that splits them at silences and fans the chunks out across several GPUs, then re-identifies speakers globally. Every worker runs preprocess, whisper, diarization, merge and LLM correction. Results and learned vocabulary persist in Postgres.
